what_it_is.prose: Ratier-Figeac, a Collins Aerospace (RTX) business based in Figeac, France, is an OEM of composite propellers and cockpit controls. It produces the 568F six-blade composite propeller family associated with turboprop airlifters of the C-295 class, as well as the A400M propellers. As the Indian Air Force operates the Airbus C-295, Ratier-Figeac propeller hardware is relevant to that fleet as an embedded sub-system supplied through the airframer rather than under a discrete, publicly documented India contract. Recorded as an honest Tier C component-supplier card; see the Collins Aerospace card for the parent entity.
